description: §15.10.1 (S458 third round, N2) — a loop binder named like a by-value prop (`for (const n of …)`, in a function body and inside a block-bodied arrow) is the loop's variable, not the prop: it is neither substituted nor reported as a write to the prop, and the caller's cell `@v` is never written. Outside the loop `n` is the prop (7). Total 6 + 10 + 20 + 7 = 43. (A C-style `for (let n = 0; …)` STATEMENT directly in a component-body function fails E-SCOPE-001 on main as well (the component re-parse drops a declaration-form C-style init), and inside a block arrow it emits an EMPTY arrow body (`/* block body */`) on main and head alike — both pre-existing — so the C-style header is pinned in the unit suite, not executed here.)
rationale: §15.10.1 Shadowing: 'A `for-stmt` loop variable … shadows props within their respective scopes.'
